Description: One value per row. For a list, add more rows below with the same Setting name (or leave the Setting cell empty). Rows whose Setting starts with # are headings. Leave Value empty if a setting is not used. Relative paths are relative to the common_files directory. LibreOffice: when opening, set the Value column type to Text so values like 4:0:0 are not changed. Then run: csv2config.py <block>.config.csv
Optional helper variables (e.g. a path you use many times). Add rows here and use them below as $NAME. flowgen does not need any of them.
Example helper variable. Leave empty if not used.
Top-level design (module) name.
Flows to generate, one row each. Default: rtl2syn (RTL vs synthesized netlist).
RTL language: sverilog (default), verilog or vhdl.
Directories searched, in order, for RTL file names given without a full path (in RTL_FILES and inside .f files). One row per directory.
RTL files or .f file lists, one row each. A .f file has one file per line; // and # start comments; $NAME uses config variables, then environment variables.
Include directories for `include files, one row each. Also searched for RTL file names after RTL_SEARCH_DIRS. Not for vhdl.
Verilog macros, NAME or NAME=VALUE, one row each. Not for vhdl.
Directories searched, in order, for netlist file names given without a full path. One row per directory.
Synthesized netlist files or .f file lists, one row each.
Place-and-route netlist files or .f file lists. Not used by rtl2syn.
SVF guidance file from synthesis. Recommended for Formality.
Timing constraint files, one row each. Not used by Formality.
Power intent files, one row each. Not used by flowgen yet.
Library file format: db (default, read_db) or lib (.lib or .lib.gz, read_lib).
Library files (standard cells, memories, hard IPs), one row each. Only these exact files are read.
Verilog models for hard IPs or cells without a library model, one row each. Read into both reference and implementation. Can be .f lists.
Modules to black box, one row each. Nothing is black boxed unless listed here.
Keyed by tool name. Formality is formality. Empty values are left out.
Command that starts Formality. Default: fm_shell
Any Formality variable: TOOL_SETTINGS(formality,<variable>). Written as set_app_var. Add one row per variable. synopsys_auto_setup is true unless set here.
Your own Tcl file sourced in the Formality script. Hook points: setup, pre_match, pre_verify, post_verify.
Written into the run_<flow>.csh scripts.
Shell setup files to source, in order, one row each.
Environment variable to set: ENV_SETENV(<NAME>). One row per variable.
